projects.name: Mise en Place
projects.role: Solo builder & owner — product, architecture, delivery and ops
projects.description: A restaurant photographs a supplier delivery note; Gemini extracts the supplier, header fields and every line with per-field confidence, and the owner only confirms what the model was unsure about. From there it becomes a daily queue ranked by euros at stake, spend analytics by item and category, unit-normalised price tracking that catches a supplier's quiet increases, budgets, payment reminders and a chat assistant over the restaurant's own purchasing data. Spanish-first and bilingual, built for independent restaurants and small groups.

highlights.title: Extraction that degrades gracefully
highlights.body: Text-PDF fast path, vision fallback and retries on the Gemini call, with per-field confidence driving a guided review of only the fields the model doubted. Structured e-invoices (Facturae 3.2.x, UBL 2.1) and VERI*FACTU QR codes are parsed directly — no AI pass, no cost, no error bar.

highlights.title: Comparing prices that aren't comparable
highlights.body: Suppliers quote the same product as a 5L garrafa, a 12-unit caja or a loose kg. Pack size, units per pack and base unit are resolved per line so everything normalises to €/L, €/kg or €/ud — which is what makes "this went up 8%" a true statement rather than a packaging artefact.

highlights.title: Multi-tenancy the CI enforces
highlights.body: Every business table carries restaurant_id and every query goes through forTenant().scope(). A custom lint invariant runs in CI and fails the build on an unscoped tenant query, so the boundary can't quietly rot as the schema grows.

highlights.title: Real async infrastructure
highlights.body: Extraction runs in a separate worker process off a pg-boss queue with dead-letter handling and an ops dashboard. Nightly jobs refresh the analytics materialised views; scheduled jobs drive the weekly AI digest and the overdue-invoice and trial-expiry emails.

highlights.title: Shipped like a product, not a demo
highlights.body: Auth.js credentials + Google OAuth, Stripe billing with per-tier entitlement gating, Sentry, Upstash rate limiting, object storage, feature flags, an admin surface for revenue, health and dead letters — and an invoice bot on WhatsApp as the MVP ingestion channel.
